shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat — plus paintable glass skylight zones (stackable, grow-light sun), mountain-top rivers with waterfalls, island-aware logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection OR compile-ref. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message on trip. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- See-below VISION extends through skylight glass; a pane is a WINDOW (installing flood-unfogs the room below). Orders through glass = orders through air.
- Selection survives column-internal view switches (switching levels is scrolling, not traveling).
- **Mountain rivers MOVE, they do not duplicate (2026-07-24): the sky channel supersedes the tunnel stretch below.**
- All levels are real maps (pocket maps, tick every game tick). Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir (Impassable) + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop (Standable) + AB_Skylight (Standable glass, dontRender).

## LIVE TEST ROUND 2 FINDINGS (2026-07-24) — river rework built, RELAUNCH PENDING
User-reported (screenshots): (1) rivers existed on BOTH levels (sky channel carved while the surface tunnel stretch stayed wet — the old "plumb projection" doc promise was the wrong hydrology); (2) the sky channel was a bare slit — only exact water cells carved, flanking rock left fogged = "gray fog of war shadow on its banks", not a vanilla-style cut.
GenStep_ABSkyRivers rework:
1. **DryTunnelStretch**: ground river cells under the carved sky channel dry to the local rock's natural rough floor (sampled from adjacent tunnel-wall rock -> tile's dominant rock -> gravel). Bridged/built-over cells (TerrainAt != BaseTerrainAt) untouched. Watercourse is hydrologically continuous: over the top, off the ledge (falls), onward at ground level — landing cells sit under open air, are never dried, and keep feeding the surface river + waterfall bases.
2. **CarveBanks**: every plain-rock neighbor of the water becomes a walkable bank (wall down, roof off, fog off, rock's rough floor). Ore veins are NOT consumed — they stand as exposed seams. Reads as a river-cut channel: water + banks + walls.
3. **UnfogSolidNeighbors**: one-ring reveal around water + banks (vanilla's open-area wall visibility) — no fog skirt on the corridor.
Bank cells cannot create false lips (lip detection requires an AIR neighbor). KNOWN GAPS: gen-time only (existing sky levels keep the old double river — regenerate the column); 1.6 water-body/fishing data on the dried stretch may hold stale cells until the tracker refreshes (cosmetic).

## LIVE TEST ROUND 1 — RESOLVED (selection wipe root cause + fog-reveal + stairs option + RMB diagnostic; see 11th pass)
## RMB 1:1 PARITY BATCH — built (ReplayFresh, column-wide selection eligibility, hop-chain routing, glass clicks, stairs option, diagnostic) — NOW reachable with selection preserved. ROUND-2 VERIFICATION STILL PENDING for RMB items (user session pivoted to rivers).
## DIRECT-TO-BLUEPRINT HAULING — built. BELOW-LEVEL LIGHTING — built (`belowLighting` ON). ANIMAL FLOW FIX — built. BAM COMPAT — built. PERF PASS + PERF-MOD AUDIT — complete.
## BATCH D — skylights (+fog reveal) built; rivers REWORKED this round. BATCH A user-verified; B/C pending.
## SETTINGS — seven tabs (+skylights, mountainRivers, skyVisitorArrivals, hospitalityRoaming, belowLighting).

## Test plan (RELAUNCH round 3, isolated — PRIORITY ORDER)
1. **Rivers (fresh column on a river-under-mountain tile)**: sky channel with walkable rock banks, no fog skirt, ore seams visible; surface UNDER the mass = dry rock floor (no duplicate river); falls at ledges; surface river resumes wet beyond the mass; flow direction matches.
2. **Selection persistence**: select colonist -> switch level -> still selected.
3. **Cross-level RMB construction**: undrafted pawn, blueprint on another level -> enabled prioritize row -> routes + delivers fresh. Stairs right-click -> "go up/down via". Any anomaly -> "AB: RMB diagnostic" on the cell.
4. **Skylight window** (daytime, sealed room) -> revealed + visible. Below lighting: lamp below at night visible from above.
5. Direct-to-blueprint: construction-only pawn carries straight to site.
Then: animal flow, BAM (companion), Batch B remainder, C, perf-mod smoke, older stack.

## Compat
(unchanged) + Better Architect Menu. Perf mods audited. INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-24 (12th pass): **mountain-river rework (supersede + banks + rim reveal) built compile-green**. Awaiting relaunch for round 3 (fresh column required for river verification).
